implementation.summary: Task 0011 establishes the strict rack-beta and Packet syntax boundaries, adds tested supported alternatives and complex user scenarios, introduces a native bounded grouped Flowchart fallback, and resolves every visual defect found in the first full gallery audit. Shared routing no longer consumes box borders; Pie and Radar compensate for terminal cells; Venn labels keep clearance; State pseudo-states close; Journey and Timeline use compact width-aware layouts; and native ER routes connect entities, cardinalities, labels, direction, and line type. A reproducible ASG workflow renders the 29 supported families plus four user scenarios as inspectable SVGs.

verification.summary: All required checks passed on the clean committed implementation. The current gallery regenerated 33/33 SVGs at a 100-column terminal, representing every one of the 29 supported families plus four user scenarios, and the complete image set was individually inspected with no remaining actionable visual finding.
